structured.answer: Harel has a lot (גמל להשקעה, השתלמות, pension, kids' savings…). In the tab that was open, the stocks track shows 24.04% a year over 3 years and the S&P 500 track 13.7%, both at about 0.56% fee, so I'd lean to stocks or S&P. But it's all under 'קופת גמל להשקעה', which I'm not sure is for me, so I wouldn't move money today.
